description.content:
Add a new milestone to a specific contract. Milestones represent distinct deliverables or phases in the contract and can include additional details such as attachments.
 **Token scopes**: `milestones:write`

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the Deel contract where the milestone will be added.
(Required) The unique identifier of the Deel contract where the milestone will be added.

header.description:
(Required) ## Authentication
The Deel API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests. All API calls must be made over HTTPS — calls over plain HTTP or without authentication will fail.

```curl
curl -X GET 'https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/v2/contracts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR-TOKEN-HERE'
```

[Learn more about authentication](/api/authentication)
